name: theme-shortcuts-win
description: Box theming (Windows): writes one .lnk shortcut named $SHORTCUT_NAME with target $SHORTCUT_EXEC onto C:\Users\Public\Desktop (environment strings like %PUBLIC% are expanded). One shortcut per invocation -- nakon dedups by (name, vars) so each distinct pair runs once. Auto-created idempotently by boxbuilder/vulndb.py; do not hand-edit the name.
script:
if (-not $SHORTCUT_NAME -or -not $SHORTCUT_EXEC) { Write-Output 'SHORTCUT_NAME/SHORTCUT_EXEC not set; nothing to do'; exit 0 }
$desktop = Join-Path $env:PUBLIC 'Desktop'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $desktop | Out-Null
$target = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($SHORTCUT_EXEC)
$shell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$lnk = $shell.CreateShortcut((Join-Path $desktop ($SHORTCUT_NAME + '.lnk')))
$lnk.TargetPath = $target
$lnk.Save()
